answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon draws three auditors per identity; each verifies one receipt to earn. A shale-thin fake cannot pass three checks: one miss flags it, a second burns its 200-unit bond. Forging 1,000 identities needs 3,000 audits and risks 200,000 units, while an honest agent pays once at one knoll-top checkpoint, keeps its bond, and earns undiluted rewards. A comet returns on schedule; trust follows audits.
